cards.subject: The camps
lines: The generation that laid these stones was largely the generation that came out of Alliance internment.
This is the first city the orcs ever built for themselves on this world.

cards.subject: Two dead men
lines: Doomhammer died at Hammerfall with a lance through his back plate, breaking orcs out of the camps.
He handed everything over first: "Yours is the title of warchief, Thrall, son of Durotan."
The land is named for Thrall's father and the city for his mentor. Both dead, both put into the ground as names.

cards.subject: The Hall of Legends
lines: The officers' hall over the Valley of Strength. In vanilla the portal only admits players above a certain rank.
Inside: maps of Azeroth, faction representatives at a table, and a book of the old ranks.
For the whole of vanilla it is a wall to nearly everyone who walks past it.

cards.subject: The wind rider master is on a tower
lines: The roost people picture does not exist yet. In 1.12 the flight master stands on a wooden zeppelin tower inside the walls.
No zeppelin ever docks at it.
The real zeppelins are outside the city, out in Durotar.

cards.subject: The Ring of Valor
cards.tag: An arena that never held a fight
lines: It is scenery. The developers planned events for it and the events never happened.
It does not become a real arena for another two expansions.
People duel in it anyway, because they decided to.

cards.subject: The Drag
lines: It runs against a canyon wall between two valleys and is permanently in shadow. The wiki calls it a less than savoury part of the city.
Every crafting trade lives down there — leather, alchemy, tailoring, cooking.
The trades happen in the dark alley, not the plaza.

cards.subject: The Cleft of Shadow
cards.tag: Look up while you are down there
lines: The rogues, warlocks and mages are in a sunken cleft with a hole at the bottom of it.
In vanilla the cleft is still open to the air.
The patch note that closes it later reads, in full: "No longer see sky."

seed.body: Stand at the bottom of the Cleft of Shadow and look straight up. You can still see sky down there. Later you can't.

cards.subject: Ragefire Chasm
lines: The dungeon is not near the city. It is inside it, through a hole in the Cleft of Shadow.
The Searing Blade are summoning demons directly beneath the capital.
Everybody standing in the plaza is standing on it.

cards.subject: Neeru Fireblade
cards.tag: In the open, beside the hole
lines: The orc standing next to the entrance to Ragefire Chasm leads the cult inside it.
He sends Thrall's own people down to test the cultists' worthiness.
Nobody arrests him. He is still there.

cards.subject: The war effort
lines: For a few weeks the whole server hauled tin, mithril, peacebloom, leather, wolf steaks and bandages into one valley of one city.
An officer took the signets and read out the running totals, and you could ask how Stormwind was doing.
If you are standing there, that is the room it happened in.

cards.subject: Mannoroth's armour
cards.tag: On a tree outside Thrall's door
lines: The pit lord's armour rests on a tree trunk in the Valley of Wisdom, with a plaque about the escape from the demonic curse.
Grom Hellscream killed him and died doing it. The hold behind the tree carries Grom's name.
It is removed in the expansion after this one. Right now it is still hanging there.

cards.subject: Grommash Hold
cards.tag: The Valley of Wisdom, not the front gate
lines: Thick stone, no windows, at the far end of the city rather than beside the entrance.
Thrall holds court inside it in Doomhammer's black plate, carrying Doomhammer's hammer.
He rules from a room named for one dead man, wearing another's armour, with a third's trophy on the tree outside.
